K01.drivers: Average proportions, normal waist taper, normal S-curve spine in profile, ordinary limb segment lengths

K02.drivers: Slim average build, ordinary trunk taper and profile curve

K03.drivers: Profile shows a deep, forward-rounded chest/belly mass and a thick upper back; front view is still ordinary. Reads as a heavier human rather than a different structure

K05.drivers: Slightly wider hips and thighs, normal taper and curve; well within human range

K06.drivers: Very broad, squared shoulder line with a blocky trunk that stays wide down to the hips with little waist; thick upper arms; sloped trapezius-like mass. Could also be a very muscular or bulky human
axial_cues: box-shaped trunk with little waist taper

K07.drivers: Ordinary build, slightly longer legs, normal profile

K08.drivers: Profile has a big forward/backward bulge in the upper trunk (keel-like chest and humped back) that narrows sharply to a pinched waist; thin limbs with angular, kinked knee and shin outlines; slightly long arms. The structure differs, not just the fat or muscle

K09.drivers: Very wide, flat-topped shoulders and a straight-sided rectangular trunk with no waist; rounded humped upper back in profile; long arms. Segment relations differ from a typical muscular human

K10.drivers: Deep chest and upper back in profile, strongly projecting buttocks, squared shoulders; reads as a bulky or muscular human with some forward trunk lean, but resembles the K06/K09 shape

K11.drivers: Same pattern as K08: bulging keel-like upper trunk in profile, sharply narrow waist, thin limbs with kinked knee and shin contours

K12.drivers: Lean, fairly broad-shouldered but ordinary taper and profile

distinguishing_features: K08/K11: profile with a large rounded upper-thorax bulge (front and back) narrowing to a sharply pinched waist and narrow pelvis, thin legs with angular knees and shins; this group is clear. K06/K09 (and possibly K10): very wide flat shoulder yoke, a rectangular trunk with little or no waist, thick, uniform limbs and a humped upper back. This group could instead be extreme muscular or bulky humans, so it is less certain.
